sample_mapping_evidence: Exact GEO GSM9992911/KT08836 and supplementary PB08836-041 row/filename match. One specimen; fixed FLEX comparisons and cultured virus-specific T-cell expansions are not additional biological specimens.

source_processing: Multiplexed sequencing data were prepared using a preprocessing pipeline based on 10x Genomics CellRanger software using the  Fixed RNA Profiling capability (version 9.0.1), with the 10x Genomics GRCh38/hg38 Human Transcriptome Reference (refdata-cellranger-GRCh38-3.0.0; based on the GRCh38 genome reference and Ensembl v93 transcriptome annotations; Released Nov. 19, 2018) to generate cell x UMI count matrices for each sample

Data from individual samples assembled across all wells were given a first pass of cell type labels using Seurat label transfer with reference to the PBMC dataset provided by the Satija Lab (Stuart and Butler, et al. (2019); DOI: 10.1016/j.cell.2019.05.031) and provided online with the Seurat PBMC scATAC-seq vignette (v 3.0; Compiled June 6, 2019).
Supplementary files format and content: h5 files, gene expression matrix, vcf files, SNP matrix

title: EXP-2012 5' 8836 Comparison - GEX
treatment_protocol_ch1: Cell Lines: Parental Jurkat T cells were originally purchased from ATCC and were transduced with pMW39 lentivirus (CXCR4 sgRNA) + pMW5 lentivirus (dCas9 ) by our group for use in other studies. No modifications were made to the native Jurkat TCR. The Raji CCL-86 cell line was purchased from ATCC. VST metabolic inhibitor treatment:  If applicable, treatment with metabolic inhibitors UK5099 (50uM, 25uM or 12.5uM, Sigma), TWS-119 (10uM, 5uM, or 1uM, Selleck Chem.) or vehicle/DMSO, was initiated on day 1 of culture. Further addition of inhibitors was done at 1x concentration and occurred only during day 7 media exchange. Individual wells were harvested at indicated timepoints during VST culture.
growth_protocol_ch1: VST culture and fixation: Culture was performed using GREX-10, 6 well plates (Wilson Wolf), largely following a previously published rapid expansion protocol (Lazarski 2021). Briefly, PBMC were thawed, pelleted at 400 xg and resuspended in 2% BSA/PBS for counting. Cells were pelleted once again and resuspended at 1.5x107 cells per mL in CTL culture media including 300ng/mL each of CMV derived pp65 and IE-1 peptide pools (Peptivator, Milltenyi) or vehicle control (water) for EXP-1993 batch and CEFSX, EBV or DMSO control for EXP-2003 batch. CTL culture media contained 44% RPMI, 44% Clicks, 10% FBS, 1% PenStrep, 1x Glutamax. Cells were incubated/pulsed for 1h at 37C. Following peptide pulse, cells were distributed into GREX-10 6 well plates containing 30mL total volume CTL media. Media was supplemented with IL4 (400U/mL), IL7, and/or IL15 (10ng/mL) as indicated. On day 7 of culture, the upper 15mL of media was carefully removed from each well without disturbing cells and replaced with 15mL fresh CTL media including 2x cytokine addition. If applicable, treatment with metabolic inhibitors UK5099 (50uM, 25uM or 12.5uM, Sigma), TWS-119 (10uM, 5uM, or 1uM, Selleck Chem.) or vehicle/DMSO, was initiated on day 1 of culture. Further addition of inhibitors was done at 1x concentration and occurred only during day 7 media exchange. Individual wells were harvested at indicated timepoints during VST culture. Upon harvest, cells were washed 1x with cold 0.4% BSA/PBS followed by 1x with cold PBS alone prior to pelleting and either resuspension in cold 10x fixation buffer per the standard FLEX protocol or cryopreserved in crystore for later use. Cells were counted and fixed at a maximum of 1x107 per mL fixation buffer. Fixation occurred for 20-26 hours at 4C. After fixation, cells were pelleted at 850 xg and resuspended in 1mL ice cold quenching buffer per 10x FLEX guideline. 10x Enhancer and 50% glycerol were added, prior to storage at -80°C, per 10x FLEX guidelines. Cryopreserved live cells for use with 10x 5' were thawed in water bath before counting and GEM generation as per 10x guidelines.
extract_protocol_ch1: Single cells were encapsulated in Gel-Beads-in emulsion (GEMs) using the 10X Controller with a Chromium Single Cell FLEX NextGEM or GEM-X Library and Gel Bead kit or 10X Chromium Single Cell 5' VDJ Library and Gel Bead Kit.

REFLEX (Library prep, pre-amp): Following GEM incubation, 125 μL of Recovery Agent was added to break the GEM emulsion. Mixtures were inverted 10x and incubated for 2 minutes at room temperature. 125 μL of recovery agent was then carefully removed from the bottom of each well. The remaining approximately 65 μL of recovered GEM sample was combined with a master mix containing 27 μL of Amp Mix (10X PN-2000047), 10 μL of Pre-Amp Primers B (10XPN-20000529), 1.5 μL of TruSeq1 [1 μM], and 3 μL of a pre-mixed TCR Variable Primer Pool (See Supplemental Note [REF]) [0.66 μM] for a total volume of 106.5 μL of master mix plus recovered GEM. Samples were inverted 10x to mix and placed in a thermal cycler with the following cycling conditions: 98C for 3 minutes; 8 cycles of 98C/20 seconds, 60C for 30 seconds, 72C for 2 minutes; 72C for 5 minutes, 4C infinite hold. Upon completion of the PCR, tubes were pulsed briefly on a minifuge to collect liquid. 90 μL was then transferred into a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube. A 1.8X SPRI bead cleanup was performed and sample was eluted into 100 μL of elution solution in accordance with 10X User Guide CG000673 Rev B.

REFLEX (library prep, re-amplification): Pre-amplified library eluates were split into two or three pools for preparation of gene expression libraries,TCR libraries, and ADT libraries (when applicable). Gene expression and ADT libraries were prepared using 20uL pre-amp product and following 10x guidelines for Multiplexed samples with Feature Barcode technology for Protein using Barcode Oligo Capture (CG000673, Rev B). Linear PCR master mix for TCR libraries consisted of 20 μL 1X KAPA HiFi HotStart (Roche, KK260), 10 uL molecular biology grade water (Fisher, BP2819100), and 0.5 μL TruSeq2 primer at 123.4 nM per reaction. TCR libraries utilized 40 μL of pre-amp product total, divided into 4, 10 μL aliquots. Each 10 μL aliquot was combined with 30.5 μL master mix in a PCR strip tube and incubated with the following PCR program: 95C/3min activation, [98C/20s denaturation, 62C/30s annealing, 72C/90s extension] repeat x4 for 5 total cycles, 72C/5min final extension, hold 4C. After the 5 cycle linear PCR was completed, 0.5 μL TruSeq1, at 123.4 nM per reaction, was spiked into each reaction and an exponential PCR was performed with the following conditions: 95C/3 min activation, [98C/20s denaturation, 62C/30s annealing, 72C/90s extension] repeated x7 for 8 total cycles, 72C/5min final extension, hold 4C. Following exponential PCR, each of the four 41 μL reactions per library condition were repooled for a total volume of 164 μL. Samples were SPRI cleaned at 0.8X ratio, eluted in 50 μL aforementioned “elution solution ”.

REFLEX (Indexing TCR Libraries): PCR indexing master mix was prepared with 50 μL 1X Kapa HiFi HotStart and 10 μL molecular biology grade water per reaction. Indexing reactions combined 20 μL cleaned re-amplified product, 60 μL master mix, and 20 μL Dual Index TT Set A (10X Genomics, PN-1000215). Each library used a unique TT index well enabling later identification via sequencing. Samples were inverted to mix and briefly spun down. Thermocycler conditions used were as follows: 98C/45s activation [98C/20s denaturation, 54C/30s annealing, 72C/90s] repeated x12-15 for 13-16 total cycles, 72C/60s final extension, hold 4C. Cycle number was adjusted to account for cell input during GEM generation. A final SPRIselect bead clean up was performed at a 0.7X ratio with cleaned product eluted into 40 μL Buffer EB (Qiagen, Cat No. 19086).

REFLEX (Indexing GEX libraries): GEX library preparation was performed separately per 10x User Guide CG000673 Rev B, Sample Index PCR guidelines, Section 4.1, using 20 μL pre-amplification product with 60 μL Sample Index PCR Mix (Amp Mix PN-2000103, Water) and 20 μL of a unique well of Dual Index TS Set A primers (PN-3000511). The combined solution was gently mixed and spun down. PCR performed per the following guidelines: 98C/45s activate, [98C/20s denature, 54C/30s anneal, 72C/20s elongate] repeat 7-14x for a total 8 to 15 cycles, 72C/60s final extension, hold 4C. Cycle number was adjusted to account for cell input during GEM generation. Indexed products were cleaned using a 1.0X SPRIselect bead cleanup and eluted in 40 μL Buffer EB.

REFLEX (Indexing ADT libraries): ADT library preparation was performed separately per 10x User Guide CG000673 Rev B, Sample Index PCR guidelines, Section 5.1, using 20 μL pre-amplification product with 60 μL Sample Index PCR Mix (Amp Mix PN-2000103, Water) and 20 μL of a unique well of Dual Index TN Set A primers for the ADT libraries (10X, PN 1000250). The combined solution was gently mixed and spun down. PCR performed per the following guidelines: 98C/45s activate, [98C/20s denature, 54C/30s anneal, 72C/20s elongate] repeat 7-14x for a total 8 to 15 cycles, 72C/60s final extension, hold 4C. Cycle number was adjusted to account for cell input during GEM generation. Indexed products were cleaned using a 1.0X SPRIselect bead cleanup and eluted in 40 μL Buffer EB.

Sequencing: Final scRNAseq libraries were sequenced using a NovaSeq X 25B PE300 or NextSeq2000 P4 300 cycle flow cell, Read1:80 Read2:200. A read depth of 5000 reads per cell for TCR libraries or 10,000 reads per cell for GEX libraries was targeted. ADT or CITEseq libraries were targeted at 5000 reads per cell. 10X 5' libraries were sequenced at a read depth of either 20,000 reads/cell for GEX or 5000 reads/cell for VDJ libraries.

10X 5’ VDJ assays were performed according to the Chromium GEM-X Single Cell 5’ v3 Gene Expression User Guide (CG000733, Rev A) targeting 29,000 cells loaded per GEM reaction. Library preparation was done in accordance with 10X guidelines per CD000733, Rev A
